side_effects: The doorway is a black slab over an uninterrupted tiled back wall, rather than a cut opening; the leaf has no parent pivot (/evidence/final_source/build.py:20-26,60-63; original object_inventory.jsonl:556-558). The simulated reflected cupboard consists of physical boxes in front of the mirror, not just a reflection (/evidence/final_source/build.py:52-59; original object_inventory.jsonl:545-555).
spatial_and_orientation_analysis: The reference and final image both show the left dark appliance, central range, small shelf behind/right, right white counter and foreground dark top. However the candidate is framed farther back: floor and island front are much more visible, the right cabinet is not cropped as in the reference, and appliances occupy a smaller image area (reference image; /evidence/executions/blender_1795841573989638875/artifacts/final.png). Camera, layout, scale and perspective are confounded; no aligned world errors are justified.

The appliance fronts face the viewer and the range burners face upward in both images; exact orientation, concealed rear geometry and absolute scale remain uncertain. The reference doorway is bright and partly occluded by a broad brown leaf, while the student has a narrow dark slit and thin leaf (same images; /evidence/final_source/build.py:60-63). The candidate's 35 mm perspective camera and geometry do not establish a common frame with GT (/evidence/independent_evaluation/common_light/capture/common_light_settings.json:189-227; /evidence/reference_gt/common_light/capture/common_light_settings.json:248-286).
appearance_and_resource_analysis: The reference wall has mottled dark gold tiles, the student wall has more uniform small gold squares; the reference countertop has visible streaking whereas the candidate's appears nearly uniform (reference and /evidence/executions/blender_1795841573989638875/artifacts/final.png).

The assigned walnut plank floor material connects Generated coordinates to Vector Math MULTIPLY (2,30,3), then Noise Fac to ColorRamp and Principled Base Color; box applies scale before assignment (/evidence/final_source/build.py:9-10,16-18). The white marble countertop has Noise Fac to ColorRamp to Principled Base Color with no explicit vector connection; it is bound to marble counter (/evidence/final_source/build.py:65-67; original object_inventory.jsonl:559-560). Default node output connection is used, not a separately implemented image map.

No image resources are referenced by the delivered source and the evaluator reports no missing external images (/evidence/final_source/build.py:1-79; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:3-7). A full-reference image-plane replacement is unsupported; scene inventory and source instead show separately modeled meshes. Packed-image status was not independently established.
geometry_analysis: The foreground island box spans z=0.26 to 1.02 while the floor top is z=0, so its body floats above the floor in the actual scene; top overlaps the box slightly (/evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:1,562-563). Reference foreground lower structure is occluded, so its support is not identifiable.

The back wall and tiles remain across the doorway, so the apparent opening is not structural (/evidence/final_source/build.py:20-26,60-63). Evaluator reported 185 AABB overlap candidates, not confirmed intersections or contact (/evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:8-16).

evaluator_only_evidence: Independent source-only reproduction generated blend and render without the external library, exit zero and no Python traceback (/evidence/independent_evaluation/source_only/reproduction.json:1-16,42). This was not a student rerun.

The independent white-world images show a bright open candidate and very dark enclosed GT; they do not establish material superiority. Existing lights were hidden and geometry, materials, cameras and residual emission retained; 16 samples without denoising (/evidence/independent_evaluation/common_light/capture/common_light.png; /evidence/reference_gt/common_light/capture/common_light.png; corresponding common_light_settings.json mutations and limits).

Original-state inventory, mask statistics, auxiliary images, AABB candidates and regeneration are evaluator products, not student inspection (/app/input_index.json:20-33; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:8-15).
unsupported_or_unknown_claims: No evidence of a library function invocation, explicit cited adaptation, causal improvement, student alternate-light comparison, physical contact verification, or actual geometry repair (/evidence/sdk_events.json:1-195; /evidence/final_source/build.py:1-79).

No aligned 3D errors or numeric visual quality scores are asserted. Wall tiles are not exhaustively mapped to GT wall because the 510 individual meshes have no actual assembly root (/evidence/final_source/build.py:20-26; original object_inventory.jsonl:2-512). GT cabinet ID 69 and nearly invisible plant ID 46 have no supported student match (/evidence/reference_gt/reference_instance_statistics.json:138-151,250-263).
limitations: Semantic correspondences are model-proposed, not manually verified or deterministic projection-mask results. Several GT assemblies are approximated by unparented separate student meshes; segmentation membership remains uncertain.

The reference is a single view; hidden surfaces, exact depth, scale and articulated geometry remain ambiguous. Inventory projected bounding boxes are unclipped bottom-up bounds, not visible masks or mask centroids (/evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:10-15).

The common-light comparison is evaluator-only and retains camera, materials, geometry, occlusion and emission confounds; differing enclosure can explain very different brightness (/evidence/reference_gt/common_light/capture/common_light_settings.json:1925-1932).
